distributionBoundaries: This archive contains license/notice texts and source-availability references, not SDK libraries, model textures, application data, credentials or build caches.
Core proprietary terms and component-specific end-user confirmation are separate product resources; a linked Core notice alone is not full agreement text or evidence of user consent.
Installer engine/translation license coverage is outside this EXE dependency collection and must be checked for the final installer.
No fresh network check of source links or universal legal clearance is claimed by assembly.

The project-owned native helper workspace declares Apache-2.0; a missing package license field is metadata, not proof of missing rights. Final release attribution must preserve upstream notices and state the integration glue license without relicensing Core/models.
Static MSVC CRT is Microsoft code. Exact local compiler/license identity was not located; no concrete conflicting redistribution condition was demonstrated. Do not strip toolchain-required notices.
